core_obligations: Obtain geometrically connected fibres on an elementary etale neighbourhood matching T.
Upgrade normality to geometric normality and reducedness.
Convert connected plus normal Noetherian into irreducible on every geometric fibre.

proof_roadmap.step: Normal-geometric bootstrapping and the connected-normal-irreducible principle.

difficulty_reason: For h : Y -> S of finite presentation and normal, and T an open subscheme of the fibre Y_s geometrically irreducible over kappa(s), the lemma finds an affine elementary etale neighbourhood (S', s') -> (S, s) and a quasi-compact open V of Y_{S'} whose fibres are all geometrically integral and with V_{s'} = T x_s s'. The retained proof is written: apply the chapter's fibre-geometrically-connected-reduced lemma to obtain the neighbourhood and V with geometrically connected fibres and the prescribed special fibre; all fibres of V -> S' are geometrically normal because normality of the map is stable under base change and open restriction (chapter lemma normal); geometrically normal plus Noetherian implies geometrically reduced, so irreducibility is the only remaining check; for t in S', the geometric fibre V_t x kappa(t)-bar is Noetherian, connected by the construction of S', and a connected Noetherian normal scheme is irreducible (Properties, lemma normal-Noetherian), which finishes. Retained author proof at lines 13345-13362.

dedup.scope: Integral-fibre neighbourhood theorem for geometrically irreducible opens of normal fibres.
